actual_scope: Follow PR6710 question 2. Freeze a common-image guard tuple and price elementary row additions above free monomial maps; determine the exact separation/anchored cost, binary guard cost, and sharp full-price envelope from two diagnostics over the ternary field.
scope_change_reason: The original card asks for a recursive connector invoice. The concrete successor handoff concerns restricted header distributions. The 945-pairing source control and selected baseline were run; the new cost unit is an explicit algebraic row addition in a separate header model.
bottleneck_link: A bundled guard caller needs a header that actually passes. Cheap coordinate permutations alone may have zero joint success; the shortest-word lower bounds quantify a restricted producer resource. A physical supplier would additionally need priced movement, scaling, selection, precision and restoration.
stop_rule: Stop at certified optimal instances and matching upper/lower sharp envelopes, literal minors on transformed inputs, independent shortest-path enumeration, rejection controls, and an offline export. Do not transfer model gate counts to the physical recursive caller.
